claims.statement: The fragment separates account billing and upgrade entitlements: organization upgrades apply to its repositories, not associated personal repositories, and personal upgrades do not upgrade organizations. This source statement is not current billing evidence or authority to purchase features.

The fragment promises support review/email within three business days, with completion link only after approval and support-contact path after denial. Request submission or elapsed time does not prove account recovery succeeded; this is pinned procedure wording, not a live service receipt.

Recovery verification may use a previously used device, configured SSH key or configured personal access token. Previously available authentication does not guarantee recovery eligibility; security restrictions or inactive-key removal can make a factor unavailable. No secret collection, credential change or recovery submission follows from this review.
